firewall_layers.mechanism: Both calls are unconditional sequential statements; each raises (BatchRealTargetBlockedError / RealTargetBlockedError|ExecutionScopeBlockedError) on deny, so run() proceeds only if BOTH allow. Each layer independently runs its own `git show origin/control/landing-orchestrator:<release json>` (layer 65-90; engine 339-385) with fail-closed None handling. Direct construction of L0Collector/Scout/run_l0_real bypasses layer_firewall but NOT the engine gate (assert_navigation_allowed -> assert_real_target_scope_allowed -> evaluate_execution_scope).

predicate_difference_between_layers.layer_firewall: status=="RELEASED" AND promoted_main_sha str len>=7 (top-level or authority_refs) AND data[allow_flag] is True AND real_target_allowed is not False; scopes known: {E000_FAST, E001_FULL} only
predicate_difference_between_layers.engine: status=="RELEASED" AND _looks_like_sha(promoted) AND real_target_allowed is not False AND (V2 only) manifest_sha256==DIAGNOSTIC_PILOT_MANIFEST_SHA256 AND data[allow_flag] is True; scopes: {E000_FAST, E001_FULL, V2_DIAGNOSTIC}
predicate_difference_between_layers.consequence: For E000_FAST/E001_FULL the two predicates are equivalent given the same document. For V2_DIAGNOSTIC the layer denies unconditionally (scope not in BATCH_LAYER_REAL_SCOPES), so run_v2_diagnostic_pilot.py cannot open REAL via BatchRunner regardless of V2_DIAGNOSTIC_RELEASE.json.
